listed_quote.quote: Terra Property Trust, Inc. (“Terra REIT”) and Terra Income Fund 6, Inc. (“Terra BDC”) today jointly announced that they have entered into a definitive merger agreement pursuant to which Terra REIT has agreed to acquire Terra BDC.

announcement.quote: Terra Property Trust, Inc. (“Terra REIT”) and Terra Income Fund 6, Inc. (“Terra BDC”) today jointly announced that they have entered into a definitive merger agreement pursuant to which Terra REIT has agreed to acquire Terra BDC.

deals.notes: Acquirer is described as a REIT (an operating company, not a closed-end fund or BDC); the cover-page Section 12(b) tables list only notes (TFSA, TPTA) on the NYSE, and the press releases print NYSE:TFSA and NYSE:TPTA, so the common-stock listing is unclear, and the release says TPT Class A stock is not yet listed. Stockholders approved the merger on September 12, 2022 (8-K 0001193125-22-243334); closing was expected on or about October 1, 2022. No excerpt states that the merger closed (the October 2022 and July 2023 8-Ks are shown only by header, and the registrant is later named Terra Income Fund 6, LLC).

problems: Completion is not stated in any excerpt. If the listing test were applied differently (both entities show NYSE tickers), the outcome would still be unconfirmed rather than failed.
